title: Ech Xao Sa Ot - – a familiar dish in everyday Vietnamese meals #vietnamesefood #asiafood #shorts
description: Stir-fried frog with lemongrass and chili is a familiar dish in everyday Vietnamese meals. Frog meat is quickly stir-fried with lemongrass, chili, and shallots, creating a fragrant aroma and a mildly spicy flavor. The meat is tender and naturally sweet, usually served with hot white rice and fresh cucumber. It is a simple yet delicious dish that many Vietnamese people enjoy in their daily meals.
